correctness.rationale: Each of the eight ray conditions and all eighteen two-cone wall relations is exhaustively covered. The four nontrivial ray conditions are exactly reduced to two strict inequalities on an open interval, eliminated by a proved sign lemma; all eighteen integer anticanonical degrees are listed. Ito–Zeng–Zeng Theorem 1.1/Corollary 3.6 then gives the iff. Exact rational wall and convex-hull checks passed for 625 independent tuples, plus 23 family instances. The analytic proof, not the sample, establishes universal quantifiers.
